svg.title: The dashboard drawing the web_world example
svg.desc: The sandbox agent on the left links to its filter task, which links to the router. The router links to net::unreachable for 0.0.0.0/0, and to one split_protocols task per machine, for 203.0.113.10/32, 198.18.0.1/32 and the gateway 10.0.0.1/32. Each split_protocols task links to a tcp::endpoint, a udp::endpoint and a net::pings task. Busy links are drawn thicker, with dots for packets moving each way.
